questions.question: Who among the following was one of the leaders who was instrumental in convincing Mahatma Gandhi about the need to start a non-cooperation movement in support of The Khilafat?
questions.solution:
• Leader: Shaukat Ali
  • Fact: Instrumental in involving Mahatma Gandhi in the Khilafat Movement.

questions.question: Pushyabhuti, who ruled from Thaneswar, was the founder of ______ dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Founder: Pushyabhuti
  • Dynasty: He was the founder of the Vardhana dynasty (ruling from Thanesar).

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Indian Association established?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1876
  • Org: The Indian Association was established by Banerjee and Bose.

questions.question: Whose administration became a model that was followed by Akbar when he consolidated the Mughal Empire?
questions.solution:
• Model: Sher Shah Suri
  • Legacy: His revenue system served as the blueprint for Emperor Akbar's administration.

questions.question: Mughal Emperor Shah Alam appointed the British East India Company as the Diwan of the province of Bengal in the year ______.
questions.solution:
• Year: 1765
  • Event: Shah Alam II granted the Diwani of Bengal to the East India Company.

questions.question: Which Mughal prince translated the Upanishads into Persian in 1657?
questions.solution:
• Prince: Dara Shikoh
  • Fact: Translated the Upanishads into Persian to bridge Hindu and Islamic thought.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first General Secretary of All India Kisan Congress?
questions.solution:
• Leader: NG Ranga
  • Role: Served as the first General Secretary of the All India Kisan Congress.

questions.question: Who among the following freedom fighters wrote the poem 'Vande Mataram' in 1875?
questions.solution:
• Author: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee
  • Poem: 'Vande Mataram', written in 1875, later became the National Song.

questions.question: Mahavira, who was known in Pali literature as Nigantha Nataputta, founded a religion called ______.
questions.solution:
• Founder: Mahavira
  • Religion: Founded Jainism (known as Nigantha Nataputta in Pali literature).

questions.question: Who among the following along with Motilal Nehru was instrumental in the creation of the Swaraj Party?
questions.solution:
• Person: Chittaranjan Das
  • Org: Co-founded the Swaraj Party with Motilal Nehru in 1923.

questions.question: The main collections of Vedic hymns are called ______.
questions.solution:
• Term: Samhita
  • Meaning: Refers to the main collections of Vedic hymns/mantras.

questions.question: In which of the following years did Japan invade India resulting in the Battle of Imphal?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1944
  • Event: Japan invaded India, leading to the Battle of Imphal.

questions.question: Alivardi Khan was a Nawab of ______.
questions.solution:
• Nawab: Alivardi Khan
  • Region: He was the Nawab of Bengal (1740–1756).

questions.question: Chandragupta led a revolt against the ______ and overthrew them.
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Chandragupta Maurya
  • Fact: Overthrew the Nanda Dynasty to establish the Mauryan Empire.

questions.question: Alamgir was the title of which Mughal emperor?
questions.solution:
• Title: Alamgir
  • Emperor: The title taken by Aurangzeb, meaning 'Conqueror of the World'.

questions.question: The ______ sultanate was ruled by the Sharqi dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Dynasty: Sharqi
  • Region: The Jaunpur Sultanate was ruled by this dynasty.

questions.question: What was the name of the women's regiment in the Indian National Army founded by Subhash Chandra Bose?
questions.solution:
• Regiment: Rani of Jhansi Regiment
  • Fact: The women's unit of the Indian National Army (INA).

questions.question: In which of the following years was the Indian Independence Act passed by the British Parliament?
questions.solution:
• Year: 1947
  • Fact: The Indian Independence Act was passed by the British Parliament in July.

questions.question: Who among the following established the Rashtrakuta Kingdom?
questions.solution:
• Founder: Dantidurga
  • Dynasty: Established the Rashtrakuta Kingdom in the 8th century.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first Finance Minister of the Independent India?
questions.solution:
• Minister: RK Shanmukham Chetty
  • Fact: He was the first Finance Minister of Independent India.

questions.question: Who was the first and last woman ruler of Delhi Sultanate?
questions.solution:
• Ruler: Razia Sultana
  • Fact: The first and only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate.

questions.question: At which of the following places did Lord Buddha give his first sermon on the Four Noble Truths?
questions.solution:
• Location: Sarnath
  • Fact: Site of Buddha's first sermon on the Four Noble Truths.

questions.question: C Rajagopalachari led the Salt Satyagraha in which of the following states?
questions.solution:
• Leader: C Rajagopalachari
  • Fact: Led the Salt Satyagraha (Vedaranyam March) in Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: A type of court called 'Kantakasodhana' was prevalent in the ______ Empire.
questions.solution:
• Term: Kantakasodhana
  • Empire: Mauryan criminal courts meant for 'cleansing of thorns'.

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the leaders of the Santhal rebellion?
questions.solution:
• Leader: Sidhu Manjhi
  • Revolt: A key leader of the Santhal Rebellion (1855).
